## Checks

- [ ] Tests are added or updated (a bug fix has a test that fails without it),
      or the description says why not.
- [ ] The documentation is updated.
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and the tests pass (Python:
      `ruff` and `pytest`); see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] A security-relevant change (authentication, input handling, sandboxing,
      cryptography) is described above.
